newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midwest hogs trade steady-up $0.50 - dealers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midwest hogs trade steady-up $0.50 - dealers.

text.p: Midwest cash hog prices early Monday were mostly steady to instances $0.50 per cwt higher, with a firm tone amid strong packer demand for hogs for early operations, livestock dealers said.
Iowa and southern Minnesota buyers said hogs sold unchanged from Friday, with $54.00 paid in the country and $55.00 to $55.50 at plants.

Illinois buyers said prices were steady to $0.50 higher, with $54.50 to $55.50 paid in the country and $55.50 to $56.00 at plants. Indiana/Ohio hogs sold steady, with $52.50 to $53.00 in the country and $53.50 to $56.00 at plants.
